Codex Resets public API attribution
=================================

Public reset announcements, observations and third-party forecasts displayed by
the optional reset-information feature are provided by Codex Resets:
https://codex-resets.com/

API documentation: https://codex-resets.com/api/docs
API schema: https://codex-resets.com/api/openapi.json

The labels of the displayed rows link to Codex Resets; tooltips and accessibility
text identify the data source. The values link to validated original Tibo posts
when a usable source URL is supplied. No API key or user account data is sent.

These records are not personal account reset times. Predictions are not an
OpenAI commitment. This application is not affiliated with Codex Resets or OpenAI.
